caption:
Is the Logitech G923 worth it at $210 for a PS5? Logitech's own US store had it at $209.99 on Nov 27, down from $229.99. It's gear-driven at 2.2 Nm, with the wheel and three pedals in the box, and TRUEFORCE adds engine and tire detail in Gran Turismo 7. About $90 more buys the Thrustmaster T248R: 3.1 Nm, smoother, Hall-effect pedals. That's the brand store's price on that date, not Amazon's: the one at checkout is the one that counts. We earn from qualifying purchases. #ps5 #granturismo7 #logitech

G923 or T248R, side by side: https://roomracer.com/compare/logitech-g923-trueforce-playstation-pc-vs-thrustmaster-t248r-playstation-pc?src=yt-answer
title: Is the Logitech G923 worth $210 for a PS5? Checked Nov 27
